## s13-v10 — argument map

Dāsadhāmni viniyojito 'py ahaṃ svecchayaiva parameśvara tvayā: even deployed in the slave's abode, by Your will. Darśanena na kim asmi pātritaḥ pādasaṃvahanakarmaṇāpi vā: am I not made worthy by seeing, or even by foot-massage? The verse: even in the slave's abode, by Your will — am I not made worthy by seeing or foot-massage?

### Open
- Whether 'dāsadhāmni' means 'in the slave's abode' or 'in the servant's place' is unresolved.
- Whether 'pātritaḥ' means 'made worthy' or 'qualified' is unresolved.
